title: Heights on weave patches: the criterion for constrained sets and the lower bound
claim: On a weave patch without holes: states are height functions up to adding 6 (Lemma 1); heights are difference constraints with extension (Lemma 2); a set is constrained exactly when m >= 3 of its members have a cyclic order of height-distance sum <= 3(m - 2) (Proposition 3); no knot is level from any distinction (Lemma 5, via cited bridged-graph theorems); D(x,y) + D(y,x) = 3 steps (Lemma 6); every bond holding x != y has at least steps + 2 members, so b >= steps + 1 (Theorem 7); lone-distinction identities (Lemma 8).
standard_statement: Triangular Ising antiferromagnet height functions; integer difference constraints; bridged graphs (Chepoi 2000; Soltan-Chepoi 1983; Farber-Jamison 1987; Chalopin-Chepoi-Hirai-Osajda 2020).
prior_work: DOUBLE-MEET-20261118-001 (the sketches and the census), RULER-20261111-001 (heights on the endless weave).
